description: Formalize-first prune of the C_knot attack: the deuteron binding deficit C_knot is NOT a single universal derivable factor. The SAME deuteron gives C_knot=5.85 (interface-inclusive per-λ sum) vs 240 (signed dim_q sum) — a 41× convention spread. Across isotopes the signed dim_q convention gives 240/40717/31475 (D/T/³He), but the triton naive sum NEARLY CANCELS (0.0002 MeV) so that 170× is a convention-specific pathology, not clean A-dependence (honest caveat). ROBUST claim: no single constant fits even the deuteron across conventions, so 'derive C_knot = 5.85' as a one-number shortcut to improve binding is REFUTED — C_knot ≡ the full convention-pinned per-partition Δ_λ, ill-posed until the weighting is pinned. scope-(a) refutation of the SHORTCUT (not a structural exclusion of a Δ_λ derivation, open, bean qou-3q7t). Connects to the convention-fragility thread of PR #4491. No fit; nothing wired; values read from two committed witnesses; exact (mpmath).
tier: scope-(a) formalize-first prune (single-universal-C_knot shortcut refuted); no fit

signed_dim_q_across_isotopes.caveat: the signed dim_q sum NEARLY CANCELS for T (B_naive=0.0002 MeV ≪ scale) — a bar-even/bar-odd cancellation pathology; the 170× is convention-specific, NOT clean A-dependence of a well-behaved deficit.

verdict.classification: scope-(a): the single-universal-C_knot SHORTCUT is refuted. A single derivable constant cannot fit even the deuteron across weighting conventions (5.85 vs 240, 41×). So 'improve binding by deriving one geometric factor 5.85' is not available — C_knot ≡ the full convention-pinned per-partition Δ_λ, not well-posed until the weighting is pinned. NOT a structural exclusion of a Δ_λ derivation (open, bean qou-3q7t); a refutation of the one-number shortcut.
verdict.connects_to: the convention-fragility thread of PR #4491 — μ₃ (baseline-class-relative), the units pun (MeV vs dimensionless), the scale ambiguity (C_knot itself). C_knot is one more convention-dependent quantity.
verdict.anti_fit: C_knot values read from two committed witnesses; nothing fitted or wired.

context.axis: Δ_λ / C_knot derivation — is it one universal factor?
